business_profile.competitive_position: Metro Weddings competes with Wedding Diary and other premium Dhaka wedding studios. Their edge is a 14-year artisanal reputation and hand-crafted grading. But premium couples still message multiple studios and book the one that confirms availability fastest. An AI agent that checks date availability instantly and captures bookings would protect their finite date inventory without compromising their boutique, unhurried brand.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With high-ticket packages and finite 2026-2027 dates, every booking lost to a faster-responding studio is unrecoverable revenue. If a 'within a day' reply window loses even a handful of weddings per season, that's lakhs in lost bookings. An AI availability + booking agent that answers instantly recovers this and fills the season calendar faster.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI availability agent that checks the couple's date against the studio calendar instantly and confirms or offers alternatives.
2. Package recommendation agent that matches the couple's needs to the right package and shares pricing.
3. Booking capture agent that locks in the date with a deposit prompt and sends confirmations.
4. Pre-wedding logistics agent that collects venue, timeline, and shot-list details before the shoot.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A couple planning a March 2027 wedding messages Metro Weddings on WhatsApp at 11pm: 'Is March 14 available?' Instead of waiting a day, the AI replies in seconds: 'March 14, 2027 is available! For a full-day wedding, most couples choose our [Package]. Want me to hold the date with a booking deposit?' The couple says yes; the date is locked with a deposit and a confirmation — before any competing studio has replied.
